title.it: Espansione CEO e agenti enterprise per WhatsApp, Twilio e fatture
title.en: CEO and enterprise swarm expansion for WhatsApp, Twilio, and invoices
title.fr: Expansion du CEO et swarm entreprise pour WhatsApp, Twilio et factures
title.es: Expansión del CEO y enjambre empresarial para WhatsApp, Twilio y facturas

features.it: Aggiunti ruoli enterprise nel sistema office (customer, finance, sales, integrations) e strumenti omnicanale per WhatsApp Business, chiamate vocali Twilio, lettura/scrittura fatture elettroniche XML SDI e gateway MCP.
features.en: Added enterprise roles to office system (customer, finance, sales, integrations) and omnichannel tools for WhatsApp Business, Twilio Voice calls, SDI XML electronic invoice parsing/generation, and MCP gateway.
features.fr: Ajout de rôles d'entreprise dans office (client, finance, ventes, intégrations) et d'outils omnicanaux pour WhatsApp Business, appels vocaux Twilio, factures électroniques XML SDI et passerelle MCP.
features.es: Añadidos roles empresariales en office (cliente, finanzas, ventas, integraciones) y herramientas omnicanal para WhatsApp Business, llamadas de voz Twilio, facturas electrónicas XML SDI y pasarela MCP.
